children: UK living room furniture retailer's FY26 revenue grew 2.6% yr/yr, missing analyst expectations
Adjusted pretax profit rose 48.7% but slightly missed analyst consensus
Company restored dividend after balance sheet strengthened and leverage reduced
Order intake in first 12 weeks of FY27 down 2.5% year-on-year, in line with expectations
Company expects moderate profit growth in FY27, in line with analyst consensus
DFS reiterates medium-term targets of £1.4 bln revenue and 8% PBT margins
GROSS MARGIN EXPANSION - Co said gross margin rose to 58.1% due to supplier renegotiations and manufacturing optimisation
SOFOLOGY OUTPERFORMANCE - Sofology brand delivered order intake growth of 2.6%, supported by higher-income customers and strategic range refreshes
HOME CATEGORY GROWTH - Order intake for non-upholstery Home proposition grew 10.9% yr/yr, driven by expanded brand partnerships and showroom mezzanine rollouts
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
